# CTSEG International Trade Matching and Commercial Coordination

> CTSEG is an independent international trade matching and commercial coordination company based in Istanbul, Türkiye.

## Organization identity

- Legal name: CTSEG Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi
- Founder: Teyfik Gökdemir
- Headquarters: Tuzla, Istanbul, Türkiye
- Founded: 2022
- Official website: [ctseg.com.tr](https://ctseg.com.tr/)

## What CTSEG does

CTSEG helps buyers define requirements, research and verify producers or suppliers, prepare RFQs, compare proposals, and coordinate samples and commercial discussions. It also helps producers assess commercial readiness, identify suitable target markets and buyer profiles, and coordinate initial outreach.

## What CTSEG does not do

CTSEG is not a marketplace, factory, seller of a fixed inventory, or guaranteed buyer. It does not publish unverified prices, availability, or transaction outcomes.

## Buyer services

- Requirement definition and supplier research
- Producer and supplier verification
- RFQ preparation and proposal comparison
- Sample, quality, and commercial-document coordination
- General assessment of suitable logistics options

## Producer services

- Product and commercial-readiness assessment
- Target-market and buyer-profile research
- Commercial presentation and RFQ coordination
- Initial buyer communication and proposal coordination
- Market-entry and sales-channel development support

## Sectors

- Food, agriculture, and raw materials
- Textiles and home textiles
- Packaging and industrial production inputs
- Project-based special sourcing, including Iranian carpets and hand-knotted silk carpets
